# Sterling Gasfitting & Plumbing

## About
Sterling Gasfitting & Plumbing is a family-owned business based in Sydney's Eastern Suburbs, founded and operated by Jay Lennox (Licence No. 372665C) with over 18 years of hands-on industry experience. Jay trained in the United Kingdom in hydronic heating, boiler installation, and strict gas compliance before bringing that expertise to Greater Sydney. The business specialises in gasfitting, hot water systems, and advanced leak detection for residential, commercial, and strata properties.

## Services
- Gas Fitting & Gas Compliance (new gas installations, gas lines, meter installations, appliance connections, compliance certificates, flue work, non-compliant gas identification)
- Leak Detection (thermal imaging, acoustic listening, electronic pipe locating, nitrogen pressure testing, hydrogen trace gas testing, gas sniffing - non-destructive)
- Hot Water Systems (gas, electric, continuous flow, heat pump, solar, commercial, emergency repairs, new installations, electrical disconnect and reconnect certified)

## Service Areas
- Eastern Suburbs, NSW
- Greater Sydney, NSW
